newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea to issue $1.17 bln equity-linked bonds.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea to issue $1.17 bln equity-linked bonds.

text.p: South Korea plans to issue $1.17 billion of equity-linked bonds in overseas markets in the third quarter, the Korea Securities Dealers Association said on Tuesday.
This compared with $1.18 billion of bonds issued a year earlier, the association said in a statement.
The association said Samsung Corp applied to issue $150 million in convertible bonds overseas in the third quarter to finance overseas projects.
Daewoo Corp plans to issue $150 million worth of convertible bonds, while Housing & Commercial Bank would issue $300 million in depositary receipts.
The association said 15 other companies applied for issues of equity-linked bonds in overseas markets.
The finance ministry liberalised the issue of such bonds from the third quarter to help South Korean companies gain cheaper overseas funding.
